summary: Verified new Laporan Kas & Pajak feature (backend /api/books/{daily,monthly,tax} + frontend /laporan-kas). 12/12 pytest cases pass covering RBAC (admin 200 / kasir 403), input validation (422 for bad date/month formats), and exact business figures for 2026-09-25 (daily) and 2026-08 (monthly + tax). Frontend Playwright walk-through as admin loads nav-books, all three tabs render correct testids and formatted IDR values matching backend exactly; nav-books is correctly hidden for kasir role.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend does not client-guard /laporan-kas route from kasir; RBAC relies on backend 403 + nav filter. This is acceptable (matches other admin-only pages like /laporan and /impor per AppShell filter), but a direct URL visit as kasir still renders the page shell with error blocks. Optional: add role gate similar to other admin pages if not already covered.
books.py PPH_RATE hardcoded (0.005) — fine for MVP but consider making it a settings/env constant if rules change.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only endpoints on existing 468 products / 7505 transactions dataset. No DB writes performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_books_reports.py is the regression suite for the Laporan Kas & Pajak feature. It requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (auto-read by pytest run in /app). Verified numbers: daily 2026-09-25 net_cash=14.885.000; monthly 2026-08 omzet=346.172.000, distributor=295.583.930, pengeluaran=38.780.500, sisa_aset=-503.175.032, pph=1.730.860. Frontend testids used: nav-books, books-tab-{harian,bulanan,pajak}, daily-date-input, month-input, daily-report, monthly-report, funding-breakdown, tax-report.
